components.dependencies: Python>=3.10,<3.14; crewai1.15.39 and matching crewai-core/crewai-cli1.15.39. Isolated project environment and lockfile. Existing provider access only; tools/litellm extras only if the actual app requires them.
components.license: MIT; retain upstream notice and independently review dependencies/assets.
adaptations: Keep CrewAI in the delivered project environment. Native Codex owns implementation, evaluation and repair; do not wrap Codex or install a second general controller.

Use crew/task interfaces for role-oriented crews and Flow interfaces for state/event-driven applications. Preserve project-specific typed contracts, failures, cancellation and checkpoint recovery rather than inventing universal framework superiority.

Default share_crew=False and tracing=False in owned app configurations; app-scoped OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true for telemetry unless knowingly opted in. Verify the pinned CoreTelemetry switch and absence of unintended trace exports. Do not override the user system-wide environment.
Memory/planning only when justified for that application; keep its data separate from the canonical personal/project knowledge path. No blanket tools/all extras or provider signup.
Checkpoints preserve framework state, not exactly-once external side effects. Give sends/submissions/writes idempotency and receipt reconciliation in the actual tool adapter.
acceptance_checks: Create/run a bounded real owned Crew or Flow with the actual available provider/tool; validate typed output and failed-tool propagation.
Interrupt/restart a checkpointed fixture; prove intended recovery and independently reconcile a simulated external action to avoid duplicate writes.
Inspect app-scoped trace settings, dependency lock, network behavior and private data boundaries. A source inspection or successful pip command is not runtime acceptance.

orchestration.delegation: Native specialists when independent work or review earns its place; no fixed team/model/effort assignment.
orchestration.recovery: Inspect actual state, preserve useful artifacts, reconcile uncertain side effects and stale work, continue authorized work.
orchestration.learning: Existing source-backed vault/native memory plus regression/structural prevention when useful; no new memory controller.
